title: Fleet Maintenance NLP Pipeline
blurb: End-to-end pipeline for US Navy work orders.
detail: Classifies unstructured maintenance work orders by priority. Handles 687 abbreviations and 1,550 misspellings across 160,000+ records. Delivered to the Department of Defense and running in production.

title: Medical Residency Matching Model
blurb: Agent-based model of application fever across 42,000+ applicants.
detail: One of the first agent-based models of application fever. Adapts Axelrod's cultural dissemination framework with prestige-biased transmission. Mean application level rises ~30% over 10 simulated years; scale explains ~99% of variance in fever outcomes.

title: The Silo Trap
blurb: A hidden equilibrium where agents feel aligned while the system fragments.
detail: Dual-metric framework separating micro-level from macro-level measurement. Across 9,000 runs, hidden fragmentation accounts for 61.9% of all fragmented equilibria, rising from 27.8% at 49 agents to 84.2% at 625 agents.

title: GraphTreeMed
blurb: Hybrid graph-tree retrieval for mission-critical medical applications.
detail: Severity-based routing with compliance verification for clinical decision support.

title: TAMOS
blurb: Task-aware multi-agent orchestrator for LLM systems.
detail: Optimizes LLM agent orchestration via hierarchical task classification, dynamic agent roles, and multi-objective evaluation. Uses Llama 3.2-3B for meta-reasoning.

title: Meta-Clustering for Conversational AI
detail: Multi-state model clustering specialized language models. A dynamic orchestrator adapts to local dialects and epidemiological data. Published at IEEE SoSE 2025.

title: Process-Oriented Digital Thread
blurb: Bridging outsourced microservices with intrinsic systems.
detail: Transitional framework using shared protocols, adaptive feedback loops, and standardized models. Part of the DoD Digital Engineering Initiative.

title: Carbon Accountability Platform
blurb: Emissions tied to operational processes, not offset purchases.
detail: Process-oriented carbon scoring under Verra VCS 4.7 and UN SDGs, with an LLM-powered training module.

title: CubeSat on SpaceX Falcon Heavy
blurb: Shape memory alloy CubeSat, still operational in low-Earth orbit.
detail: Designed and prototyped at German Orbital Systems, Berlin. Launched aboard SpaceX Falcon Heavy.

title: Bandwidth-Limited Intelligence
blurb: Does engineered intelligence have a ceiling?
detail: Proposes that engineered AI faces a bandwidth-limited intelligence ceiling arising from sensor and actuator capacity. Dual-channel model separating physical I/O from representational capacity.
